case: A check interest's precondition reads a field the producer could author, so the producer decides whether it is checked.
why: R-X20's point is that a standing check whose trigger the producer controls is a check the producer can switch off by writing a field. With the containment gone, the declared read set is unconstrained and the two lists sit beside each other proving nothing. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.check.reads_only_non_authorable_fields` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
